name: Kobe Airport

hours.v: operating hours 07:00-23:00; managed by Kobe City, run by Kansai Airports Kobe since 1 Apr 2018

curfew.v: no operations outside the airport's operating hours of 07:00-23:00 local

customs.v: business jets: departures accepted 07:00-23:00; international arrivals only weekdays 08:30-17:00 (not weekends or public holidays). Flight plan to the CIQ agencies at least 3 days before departure (24 hours in urgent business cases) and 14 days before arrival (7 days in urgent business cases)
customs.quote: 入国：平日の8時30分～17時00分（土日祝不可）

notes: Read Kobe City (airport administrator) pages: Kobe Airport overview (last updated 16 Sep 2026; 運営時間 7時～23時; international scheduled flights planned around 2030), business/private jet page (last updated 25 Oct 2024) and the city's building-height limits leaflet (undated) for the 2,500 m runway.
